## Littelfuse to Present at Upcoming Investor Conference


November, 04, 2026


Download (opens in new window)


CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Littelfuse, Inc. (NASDAQ: LFUS), a leader in developing smart solutions that enable safe and efficient electrical energy transfer, today announced that it will participate in the following investor conference:


Event: Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference


Date and Location: November 11, 2026, in Chicago, IL


Fireside Chat Time: 9:05 AM CT


Contact your Baird representative to schedule a meeting with management. In advance of the conference, interested parties are encouraged to review the Company’s most recent earnings presentation and Investor Day presentation, available on the Investor Relations section of Littelfuse.com ([investor.littelfuse.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.littelfuse.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54635482&newsitemid=20261104133877&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.littelfuse.com&index=1&md5=9b59fbcf657ca90c6cc9cbffab1a7ffd) ), for additional context on the company’s financial performance, strategic priorities and long-term objectives.


**About Littelfuse**


Littelfuse, Inc. (NASDAQ: LFUS) is a diversified, industrial technology manufacturing company empowering a sustainable, connected, and safer world. Across more than 20 countries, and with approximately 18,000 global associates, we partner with customers to design and deliver innovative, reliable solutions. Serving over 100,000 end customers, our products are found in a variety of industrial, transportation, and electronics end markets, everywhere, every day. Learn more at[Littelfuse.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2FLittelfuse.com&esheet=54635482&newsitemid=20261104133877&lan=en-US&anchor=Littelfuse.com&index=2&md5=c88f65020e54c2f97474a7a9d015b588) .
